about_short_description.short_description: Fuell is a premier expense management platform that brings SMEs' financing into the current era.

product.name: Physical and Virtual Cards
product.description: Issue physical and virtual Mastercard cards for employees to manage company expenses without sharing cards or using cash.

product.name: Budgets and Approval Workflows
product.description: Create and manage budgets with multi-level approval flows to control, review, and approve expenses by managers and budget owners.

product.name: Expense and Reimbursement Management
product.description: Manage expenses made with Fuell cards and reimbursements for expenses paid by employees automatically, eliminating manual expense reports.

product.name: Real-Time Business Intelligence
product.description: Provide detailed, real-time reports and analytics on company expenses to support faster decision-making and spending control.

product.name: ERP Integration
product.description: Connect Fuell's platform with popular ERP accounting systems to synchronize accounts and automate data export processes.

product.name: Automatic VAT Recovery
product.description: Automatically obtain invoices from over half a million retailers and generate VAT recovery documents to simplify tax processes.
